functions.residue: RESIDUE SHAPE 44 0x230 add r0, r7, #0x10 | mov r2, #3; 0x234 mov r2, #3 | add r0, r7, r0
functions.description: command menu label and description draw
functions.notes: 44 bytes differ in 5 runs. Two groups. (1) Temp registers in the two position-array setups are shifted by one (target r1/r2, ours r2/r3). (2) The tail: target does ldrsb r1,[r7,#0x18]; add r0,r7,#0x10; ldrsb r1,[r0,r1] and ours folds commands to [r0,#0x10]. Local pointer, local selected, inline helper and reordering the array declarations did not change it. colorsweep --apply made it worse (74 bytes), so it was reverted.
